answer: Ask what a clone farm cannot buy in bulk, and the answer points at Astronomer astrolabe plate assay attested by the chart charter. It requires each astrolabe plate is an eclipse record countersigned by the warden, so a farm must chart a hundred real skies by hand, so the meadow of scaling up is a queue of real-world chores. A farm doing the maths finds the oasis first: a hundred clones need a hundred proofs, and the epoch reward divided a hundred ways is already less than the cost of one. The terrace is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
